title: Something above the ranch defies rockets and manipulates drones; anomalies below it

tellings.quote: We've documented an effect that there is something within the space above the ranch that defies rockets, that manipulates drones,

plain: Something in the sky over Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, interferes with rockets and drones, and something odd lies under the ground too, says Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner. Fugal says his team has recorded this since about 2016: "there is something within the space above the ranch that defies rockets, that manipulates drones." He tells it as what his own research there has found.
